procedure get_shipprsn IS
begin
 select RTRIM(user_first_name) || ' ' || RTRIM(user_last_name)
 into :ship_person
 from system_users vu, shipments sh
 where rtrim(vu.user_id) = rtrim(sh.shipped_by_user_id) -- IM 734
 and vu.chapter_id = sh.chapter_id
 and sh.shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and sh.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 Null;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure query_note is
 pos1 number;
 pos2 number;
 pos3 number;
 ret_chr VARCHAR2(1) := chr(10);
begin
 :s_dummy_1 := null;
 :s_dummy_2 := null;
 :s_dummy_3 := null;
 :s_dummy_4 := null; 
 pos1 := instr(:s_note, ret_chr);
 if pos1 = 0
 then
 :s_dummy_1 := substr(:s_note,2, 59);
 :s_dummy_2 := substr(:s_note,61, 60);
 :s_dummy_3 := substr(:s_note,121, 60);
 :s_dummy_4 := substr(:s_note,181, 60);
 else
 :s_dummy_1 := substr(:s_note,2, pos1-2);
 pos2 := instr(:s_note, ret_chr, pos1+1);
 if pos2 = 0
 then
 :s_dummy_2 := substr(:s_note, pos1+1, 60);
 :s_dummy_3 := substr(:s_note, pos1+61, 60);
 :s_dummy_4 := substr(:s_note, pos1+121, 60);
 else
 :s_dummy_2 := substr(:s_note, pos1+1, pos2-pos1-1);
 pos3 := instr(:s_note, ret_chr, pos2+1);
 if pos3 = 0
 then
 :s_dummy_3 := substr(:s_note, pos2+1, 60);
 :s_dummy_4 := substr(:s_note, pos2+61);
 else
 :s_dummy_3 := substr(:s_note, pos2+1, pos3-pos2-1);
 :s_dummy_4 := substr(:s_note, pos3+1);
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_note is
-- Insert a note into serv_note_books
 note_exist boolean;
 temp_note_id VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 note_exist := true;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from serv_note_books
 where note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 note_exist := false;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if note_exist
 then
 begin
 update serv_note_books
 set note = :ctrl_blk_1.s_note
 where note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select notebook_seq.nextval
 into :ctrl_blk_1.note_id
 from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into serv_note_books
 (note_id, note)
 values (:ctrl_blk_1.note_id, :ctrl_blk_1.s_note);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update shipments
 set note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where shipment_no = :ctrl_blk_1.shipment_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_PROD_STAT_DL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure set_prod_stat_dl (pick_id IN VARCHAR2, bx_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
/*For all of the products that were shipped under this pick_slip_id
 and box_id, change its status to 'DL'*/
begin
 update pick_slip_products
 set product_status = 'DL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where pick_slip_id = pick_id
 and product_status = 'SH'
 and box_id = bx_id
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id;
 post;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_PRODUCTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure find_products (bx_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
/*This procedure finds all of the products under this particular box_id,
 then calls routines to set the quantity, the item status, and the
 order status*/
 bld_typ VARCHAR2(4);
 tmp_order VARCHAR2(14);
 tmp_chapter_id VARCHAR2(4);
cursor cur1 is
 select distinct pick_slip_id,item_no,chapter_id
 from pick_slip_products
 where box_id = bx_id
 and product_status = 'DL'
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 order by item_no;
begin
 begin
 for cur1_rec in cur1
 loop
 tmp_chapter_id := cur1_rec.chapter_id;
 begin
 select order_no
 into tmp_order
 from pick_slips ps
 where ps.pick_slip_id = cur1_rec.pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = cur1_rec.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 SHOW_ERROR_DIST('4900');
 /*4900 - There is no matching order for this shipment */
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 set_item_cl(tmp_order,cur1_rec.chapter_id,cur1_rec.item_no);
 end loop;
 end;
 set_order_cl(tmp_order,tmp_chapter_id);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_BOXID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_boxid IS
cursor cur1 is
 select distinct psp.box_id, psp.pick_slip_id, psp.chapter_id
 from pick_slip_products psp
 where exists (select 'x'
 from boxes
 where shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and box_id = psp.box_id
 and chapter_id = psp.chapter_id)
 and psp.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id;
begin
 begin
 update boxes
 set box_status = 'DL'
 where shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and box_status = 'SH'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;/*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 SHOW_ERROR_DIST('4308'); -- no boxes found for this shipment
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 for cur1_rec IN cur1
 loop
 set_prod_stat_dl(cur1_rec.pick_slip_id,cur1_rec.box_id);
 set_pick_cl(cur1_rec.pick_slip_id, cur1_rec.chapter_id);
 find_products(cur1_rec.box_id);
 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_PICK_CL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure set_pick_cl(temp_pick IN VARCHAR2,temp_chap IN VARCHAR2) IS
begin
 begin
 select 'x' into :Global.x
 from pick_slip_products
 where chapter_id = temp_chap
 and pick_slip_id = temp_pick
 and product_status not in ('DL','UN');
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 update pick_slips
 set pick_slip_status = 'CL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where chapter_id = temp_chap
 and pick_slip_id = temp_pick
 and pick_slip_status != 'CL';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 Null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 Null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_ITEM_CL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure set_item_cl(temp_order IN VARCHAR2,temp_chap IN VARCHAR2,
 temp_item IN NUMBER) IS
cursor cur1 is
 select item_no, required_qty, shipped_qty,
 canceled_qty, system_cancel_qty
 from order_items
 where order_no = temp_order
 and chapter_id = temp_chap
 and item_no = temp_item;
begin
 for cur1_rec in cur1
 loop
 /* Commented by Sobha PR No 001.022761 
 if cur1_rec.required_qty = (cur1_rec.shipped_qty -
 */
 if cur1_rec.shipped_qty = (cur1_rec.required_qty -
 (nvl(cur1_rec.canceled_qty,0) +
 nvl(cur1_rec.system_cancel_qty,0)))
 then
 begin
 update order_items
 set item_status = 'CL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where item_no = temp_item
 and order_no = temp_order
 and chapter_id = temp_chap;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_ORDER_CL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure set_order_cl(temp_order IN VARCHAR2,temp_chap IN VARCHAR2) IS
-- Set the status of the order to closed in order_items and orders
cl_cnt NUMBER(5);
tot_cnt NUMBER(5);
cursor cur1 is
 select item_status
 from order_items
 where order_no = temp_order
 and chapter_id = temp_chap;
begin
 cl_cnt := 0;
 tot_cnt := 0;
 for cur1_rec IN cur1
 loop
 IF cur1_rec.item_status in ('CL', 'CA', 'SY')
 then
 cl_cnt := cl_cnt + 1;
 end if;
 tot_cnt := tot_cnt + 1;
 end loop;
 if cl_cnt = tot_cnt
 then
 begin
 update orders
 set order_status = 'CL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where order_no = temp_order and
 chapter_id = temp_chap;
 post;
 exception when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 if :s_note is not null
 then
 insert_note;
 end if;
 begin --change shipment_status to Delivered
 update shipments
 set receipt_date = :receipt_date,
 received_by = :receipt_by,
 shipment_status = 'DL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where shipment_no = :ctrl_blk_1.shipment_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin --change stock_state to Delivered
 update shipped_products sp
 set stock_state = 'DL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and exists
 (select 'x' from pick_slip_products psp, boxes
 where psp.unit_id = sp.unit_id
 and psp.coll_date = sp.coll_date
 and psp.product_code = sp.product_code
 and psp.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and psp.aliquot = sp.aliquot
 and psp.blood_type = sp.blood_type
 and boxes.shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and boxes.box_id = psp.box_id
 and boxes.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 get_boxid;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 SHOW_ERROR_DIST('0000');
 /*0000 - TRANSACTION COMMITTED */
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 SHOW_ERROR_DIST('0600');
 /*0600 - Unsuccessful commit... transaction not saved */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;
